hook.text: Eighty percent of callers sent to voicemail hang up without a word. The ones who leave a message wait eight hours to be heard.

save.text: Transcribed, summarized, flagged urgent, and on the attorney's desk phone — before the caller hung up.

routine.text: Routine calls get routed, not stacked. The attorney only sees what needs the attorney.

cta.text: Want your voicemail read, sorted, and on the phone screen? Let's build it.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Lakeside Family Law, this is Quinn. Everyone's in court right now — I can take a detailed message for the right attorney. What's going on?

call1.speaker: caller
call1.text: Hi, it's Rachel Kim. My custody hearing got moved to Monday at nine and the other side filed a motion. I need Daniel to call me before three today.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Got it — hearing moved to Monday nine AM, a new motion, and you need Daniel Okafor back before three. I'm marking this urgent and putting it on his phone now.

call2.speaker: caller
call2.text: Hi, Priya Desai. I have a question about a filing fee on invoice two-two-nine-one. No rush.

call2.speaker: alex
call2.text: No problem, Priya — that's a billing question, so I'm sending it straight to our billing team. They'll call you back today.
